g.text: < low select, > high select, f(x) characteriser
C-105 pressure PIC-1091 by hot-vapour bypass PV-1091 around the flooded condenser A-106; normally no off-gas (total condenser). C-106 pressure
PIC-1100 on the flooded-condenser outlet PV-1100, set as low as A-107 allows (floating pressure under MPC).
Material balance: reflux-drum levels LIC-1092/1101 cascade to distillate product FIC-1093/1102 (averaging); bottoms levels LIC-1097 (to C-106,
averaging - surge for C-106 feed) and LIC-1106 to HN.
Energy balance (bottom): sensitive-tray temperatures TIC-1095 (stage ~15) and TIC-1104 (tray 30), pressure-compensated, cascade to reboiler steam
Top quality: reflux on ratio to feed (C-105, FFY-1094) or flow (C-106, FIC-1103).
Dual-composition: MPC moves reflux/(L/F) and tray-temperature SPs on GC analysers (AT-1099, AT-1108, AT-1109) and inferentials; interaction handled by
Without MPC: single-ended composition control (tray T) with reflux on ratio - operator trims.
SIF-110: C-105 high-high pressure PZHH-1091 closes reboiler steam XV-1096 (PSV relief load reduction). SIF-109: D-105 low-low level LZLL-1092 closes
LPG product XV-1093 (prevents gas blow-by to LPG treating).
